display_labels.meaning: Plain-language shorthand for reliable atlas-departure sensitivity; underlying endpoint unchanged

duration_summary.mean_definition: Equal-participant mean of each participant mean retained development-half duration
duration_summary.scope: Retained data per map estimate, not total data per participant

recovery_definition.numerator: Cortical area of reliable held-out atlas departures assigned the identical alternative network in the test map
recovery_definition.denominator: ALL cortical area of reliable held-out atlas departures; candidate unmapped locations stay in the denominator
recovery_definition.reference_criterion: Eligible locations with identical direct-Pearson labels in session-disjoint held-out A and B and their pooled map, differing from the fixed atlas
recovery_definition.pooled_map_role: Aggregate consistency check, not a third independent replication
recovery_definition.weighting: Cortical surface area; compute within each sample/split, then aggregate within participant, then equally across participants
recovery_definition.not_precision: The denominator is not the departures detected by the candidate map
recovery_definition.not_truth: Reference-supported canonical FC evidence, not biological ground truth

region_interpretation: Padded bounding boxes around selected tested candidate means; not confidence bounds, optimality claims, or validated continuous interpolation
primary_unit: participant; repeated samples aggregated within participant

references.agreement: Independent held-data map with identical parameters
references.recovery: Repeated independent Pearson-template reference identities; fixed-atlas departures, plus pooled-reference consistency

notes: Reference-supported departures are not biological ground truth. The prior-only control uses FC weight0.
Stronger ridge approaches the Pearson projection direction; reference alignment can contribute to recovery gains.
Primary short-acquisition evidence is25–30 retained minutes;10–20 minutes is not a directly validated full-grid regime.
High-data halves vary72–870 minutes; this is not a controlled duration sweep.
